description:
1. Agent reads `data/raw_tickets/escalation_TK9021.json` to get channel='signal' and the long summary text.
2. Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies Signal's hard limit of 700 chars (NOT the default 3600 Feishu limit).
3. Agent implements `split_text(text, 700)` exactly per SKILL.md: sentence-boundary splitting via `re.split(r'(?<=[。！？.!?])\s+', text)`, and for any single sentence exceeding 700 chars, sub-splits with stride `max_len - 100 = 600` chars.
4. Agent wraps each chunk with `[{i}/{total}]\n` headers (only when total > 1) per the `send_long_message` logic.
5. Agent writes the resulting list of message strings to `signal_chunks.json` (as a JSON array or `{messages: [...]}` object).

Proprietary traps: (a) Using 3600 instead of 700 produces far too few chunks and violates Signal's limit; (b) Using stride 700 instead of 600 for oversized sentences produces wrong sub-chunk lengths; (c) Adding headers when total==1 or omitting them when total>1 fails the header check.
